description: Reference packet for the conditional super-Tannakian matter lift (issue #314). The hash-pinned #566 packet proves the exact algebraic consequences of a declared charged-double-triplet current fixture. Its #599 artifact source-binds the target-blind carrier response constraints without selecting that current representation or its Lie bracket. Conditional on the fixture, BLOCK-DETERMINANT-BALANCE derives the primitive charge pair up to charge conjugation; the exhaustive 1024-subset anomaly scan selects the unordered conjugate rank-fifteen pair with the fermionic-parity grading as an output; and the hash-pinned spin statistics artifact supplies the non-split transport double cover used to implement that grading. The statistics and category contracts below are validated inside this conditional algebraic model. Scalar charge and channel compatibility are exact only conditional on the declared weak-doublet scalar content; scalar existence and economy remain open.

exterior_matter_contract.note: the charge pair must lie in the derived conjugate primitive pair and the declared channels must match the exact compatibility calculation. One weak-block scalar is a branch assumption; existence, multiplicity, and no-extra-scalar economy are not derived.

statistics_contract.note: matter states are built from anticommuting auxiliary CAR generators; the abelian bosonic coefficient records of the screen lane are a different typed object

spin_lift.note: the kernel-block action must be lifted through a genuine double cover; a split lift is rejected against the derived unique-involution witness

category_contract.note: the verifier derives the unordered conjugate pair consisting of the even-minus-vacuum and odd-minus-top rank-fifteen projectors; neither representative is physically preferred

kernel_emission_contract.note: the common action kernel on every realized matter tensor is emitted as data for the downstream global-form descent; the final quotient is not chosen here

candidate_matter_class.note: this packet proves the declared class nonempty by realization; class uniqueness stays in its own lane
